comments.content: [medium] For the HANA partitions, the empty `<items>` element would be cleaner as a self-closing tag (`/>`) rather than a pair of separate opening and closing tags.

[medium] This chain of conditions can behave in surprising ways: if LEVEL_1_RANGE_MIN_VALUE is empty while LEVEL_2_RANGE_MIN_VALUE has a value, and LEVEL_3_RANGE_MIN_VALUE is also populated, the latter will overwrite the value just assigned from LEVEL_2_RANGE_MIN_VALUE. An else-if chain, or breaking out after the first assignment, would prevent that.
[low] Add a test that confirms `HANAPartition` does not change the behavior of unrelated inputs.
[low] Please check that `<items>` remains understandable when the caller takes the early-return path.
